parole.significato: alcohol (any of a class of organic compounds (such as ethanol) containing a hydroxyl functional group (-OH))
parole.testo: Borrowed from English alcohol, with influence from Arabic الْكُحْل (al-kuḥl) (a direct boring from Arabic would drop the definite article ال (al-)). Compare Urdu اَلْکُحُل (alkuhul). Doublet of کحل (kuhl /kohl) and (Iranian Persian) الکل (alkol).
